tbl_description: On-effort visual survey segments (Michaela Alksne's QA/QC'd product, Scripps Whale Acoustics Lab): one row per segment with start/end position and time, the on/off-transect flag and the length. Sightings join on segment_id. Published as core `sample` rows (sample_type `transect`), with `transect_length` in `sample_measurement` for the on-transect segments.

On-effort cetacean sightings (same product): one row per sighting, or per species of a mixed group, with position, time, sighting conditions, observer, reticle distances, group size best/min/max, calves and species code (behaviour codes are held, Q03). Published as core `sample` (sample_type `sighting`, child of its segment), `obs` (group_size) and `obs_attribute` (transect status, min/max, calves).

The lab's species-code list (code, common name), reconciled with metadata/sio/cetacean-sightings/species_codes.csv, which adds the codes the sightings use beyond it and the scientific name each code is resolved from. Published as `dataset_taxon` rows.
